annotations.title: Update a review's summary or title

description: Set or replace a review's summary and/or title. The summary is shown at the top of the review, above every screenshot and note. Replaces any existing summary or title.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

compared_to.description: Optional: when this run repeats an earlier study, the earlier review's slug or URL. Recorded so re-runs can be compared over time.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

summary.description: The overview shown at the top of the review. Replaces any existing summary.

name: update_review
